technique_name: Explain the value of a "growth mindset".
description: A “growth mindset” is a mindset developed by Stanford psychologist Carol Dweck that emphasizes that qualities such as intelligence and abilities can be developed and improved through effort and perseverance. People who hold this belief tend to be more resilient in the face of challenges and are more likely to see failure as a learning experience, rather than a stamp of permanent inadequacy.
